resources.string: Shows the running workout with its timer and buttons to log a set or control the rest timer.
Sounds when a rest timer reaches zero while the app is in the background.
How Pulse Strength uses Health Connect

If you turn it on in the app\'s settings, Pulse Strength saves each finished workout to Health Connect as a strength-training session: its start and end time, its name and the number of sets and total weight lifted. The app only writes; it never reads anything from Health Connect.

Pulse Strength works entirely on your device. It has no accounts and no internet access, so nothing you log is sent anywhere. You can turn this off at any time in the app\'s settings or in Health Connect.
